gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma (GBM); Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma; GBM; Glioblastoma Multiforme (GBM); Glioma; Central Nervous System Diseases; Brain Cancer
Newly diagnosed histologically confirmed glioblastoma that is isocitrate dehydrogenase wild type (IDH-WT).

candidate_evidence.quote: The purpose of this study is to see if combining silevertinib with temozolomide after surgery and radiotherapy helps treat newly diagnosed glioblastoma (GBM) better than using temozolomide alone in the maintenance setting.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: At least 4 weeks since completion of radiation therapy, with a post-radiation MRI showing no progression.
better than using temozolomide alone in the maintenance setting

role_evidence.quote: silevertinib at dose determined in Part 1 until disease progression in combination with temozolomide 150-200 mg/m2 orally once daily on Days 1 to 5 of each 28-day cycle for maximum of 6 cycles

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Silevertinib was designed to block a growth signal important to some cancers where tumors grow because of changes in a protein called epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR).

role_evidence.quote: Participants randomized to Arm B will receive temozolomide 150-200 mg/m2 orally once daily on Days 1 to 5 of each 28-day cycle for maximum of 6 cycles
It is the standard treatment for adults with certain types of newly diagnosed brain cancer, like GBM.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care

source_quote.quote: Newly diagnosed histologically confirmed glioblastoma that is isocitrate dehydrogenase wild type (IDH-WT).

coder_notes: Part 1 safety lead-in requires 'EGFR alterations' (not a separately registered arm); Part 2 randomised requires EGFRvIII and unmethylated MGMT, applying to both registered arms. The overall EGFR-positive requirement applies to the whole trial (eligibility). The registered intervention 'silevertinib in combination with temozolomide' bundles both drugs; listed as separate rows. Comparator arm is a registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR, so control_arm_from_other_arms = no.
